import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0118 {α : Type*} {l₁ l₂ : List α} : l₁.Subperm l₂ → l₂.Subperm l₁ → l₁ = l₂ := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0118 {α : Type*} {l₁ l₂ : List α} : l₁.Subperm l₂ → l₂.Subperm l₁ → l₁ = l₂ :=
  by
  intro h1 h2
  have h3 : ∀ (a : α), List.count a l₁ ≤ List.count a l₂ := by
    apply List.subperm_iff_count.1 h1
  have h4 : ∀ (a : α), List.count a l₂ ≤ List.count a l₁ := by
    apply List.subperm_iff_count.1 h2
  have h5 : ∀ (a : α), List.count a l₁ = List.count a l₂ := by
    intro a
    exact le_antisymm h3 h4
  have h6 : l₁ = l₂ := by
    apply List.count_eq_count.1 h5
  exact h6
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0118 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0118 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0118

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0118
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0118
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
